title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly derives and states E = mv₀²/(2qR) from work-energy theorem and geometry.

title: Maximum KE increase velocity
description: Essential: Correctly determines initial velocity for maximum kinetic energy gain as v₀√2/4.

title: Momentum change velocity
description: Essential: Correctly identifies both possible initial velocities (0 or v₀√3/2) that yield momentum change mv₀.

title: Projectile motion analysis
description: Important: Applies projectile kinematics with constant acceleration qE/m to relate displacement components to time.

title: Geometric displacement relations
description: Important: Uses geometry of circle (R, 60°) to determine vertical and horizontal displacements relative to field direction.

title: Work-energy application
description: Important: Recognizes that work done by electric field equals change in kinetic energy, independent of path for uniform field.

title: Vector momentum change
description: Important: Calculates momentum change as vector difference, considering both magnitude and direction of final velocity.

title: Sign/direction confusion
description: Pitfall: Treats momentum change as scalar sum instead of vector difference, or misidentifies field direction.

title: Geometry misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly determines vertical/horizontal displacements from the given 60° angle and circle geometry.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Verifies dimensional consistency of final answers (E in N/C, velocities in m/s).
